why: A delivers exactly what was asked: a pale solid-wood table for four, simple black wooden chairs, a white bell pendant and a low sideboard, all in a coherent Nordic look; only the knotty yellowish pine of the open-cube sideboard is a slight mismatch with the birch and the kitchen's greige wood. B's table has a white top rather than the light wood requested, and the gold-legged herringbone sideboard leans glam rather than simple Nordic, so the set feels less unified.
